name: @sheetwrite/docs-solid
description: The docs site on TanStack Start with Solid, static pages with islands. Replaces docs/ when the migration (#504) completes.

scripts.build: bun run generate && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite.islands.config.ts && bun src/islands/page-scripts.ts && bunx pagefind --site dist/client
